messages:
carmen: PR #18422 merge blocked — linux smoke failing on shard-7 CI. Anyone able to give eyes? failing snapshot shows timeout in TestRealtimeKVIntegration::SnapshotConsistency. log excerpt below

devon: looking now — can you paste the failing stack / test name?

carmen: test: TestRealtimeKVIntegration::SnapshotConsistency
error: assertion timeout after 200ms, observed 520ms
```
[shard-7] kv-client.go:214 | waitForSnapshot: timeout waiting for consistent snapshot (waited 520ms)
```

mike: saw something similar yesterday on linux nodes — tends to spike when batch-processing jobs run concurrently. could be kvcache eviction / scheduling under load.

lee: fyi I attempted a local docker run on ubuntu-22.04 and couldn't repro. sounds infra-noise-y. can we do a targeted shard rerun?

carmen: requested targeted rerun via ci-bot — queued it now.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: PR 18422 | target: shard-7 | owner: carmen | started at 1761112250

oncall: tagging @devops — if this test flakes >3x in 24h we should consider quarantining it (skip on linux for merge window) to avoid blocking merges.

devon: my 2c: i'd prefer a minimal fix in the test to reduce blast radius. proposal: bump assertion timeout 200ms -> 1s and add a short stabilization sleep (50ms) before the critical assert. also add a comment `// flaky-linux: tracked-ticket-XXXX` not to hide it permanently.

mike: agree with minimal stabilization first. sleeping is gross but cheap; let's add a TODO to follow up with root-cause investigation.

carmen: i can open a tiny PR with the test tweak + comment. we still need review/approval fast — @tim can you take this? merge window closes in ~2h.

tim: i can review in ~30m. if rerun passes, and change is small, i'm fine approving. ping me once ci finishes.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: shard-7 -> PASS (1761112305). No snapshot changes detected.

carmen: great — i'm going to open the test-stabilize PR and tag tim for review. i'll also file a follow-up ticket to investigate kvcache eviction timing under concurrent batches. thanks all :thumbsup:
